title: Customer Service Advisor

Tired of sales? Want a customer service role instead? This may be just the role for you We are recruiting for a customer service advisor for our client in the Crawley area of West Sussex. As a Customer Advisor you will: - Exceed customers expectations and keep customer service standards maintained - Handle inbound telephone calls and e-mails from customers - Support all aspects of the customer journey from product queries, advice and aftersales care - Take ownership of any general issues, finding suitable solutions for customers - Providing prompt, efficient and consistent information and communication in line with company policy - Liaise with other departments to ensure best service is maintained - Build a strong relationship with the team and customers. The ideal candidate will have - Great spoken and written communication skills - The ability to build a rapport with people quickly and effectively - A professional and pro-active attitude with exceptional attention to detail. - Excellent organisational skills and a passion for providing outstanding customer service - The ability to problem solve quickly and take ownership comfortably - Confident, resilient and assertive decision-making skills - Great MS Office skills - Customer Service experience - Experience in an electrical wholesale business is essential This is a great opportunity to join a growing business with plans for future expansion. If you feel that you have the right skills for this opportunity, please send us your CV. All applications are dealt with in the strictest of confidence. We strive to be the industry leader in delivering the highest calibre of candidates to our client companies, whilst enhancing the careers of our candidates. For further information and contact details, please visit our website.

title: Customer Service Representative
description: Are you an experienced Customer Service Advisor who enjoys helping people, resolving enquiries and providing excellent customer support? We are recruiting for a Customer Service Advisor to join an established organisation in Newton Abbot. This is a full-time, permanent, office-based opportunity within a business supplying specialist products that make a genuine difference to people's lives. The position would suit someone with experience in customer service, customer administration, order processing or customer support who enjoys working in a busy, team-focused environment. The Role Working as part of the Customer Service team, you will be responsible for handling customer enquiries, processing orders and ensuring customers receive accurate information and a professional service. Key responsibilities include: - Handling incoming telephone calls and email enquiries. - Processing customer orders, quotations and enquiries accurately. - Monitoring orders through to delivery and providing customer updates. - Responding to product, warranty, servicing and repair enquiries. - Handling customer complaints and resolving issues professionally. - Liaising with internal departments, including sales, production, warehouse and logistics. - Maintaining accurate customer information using CRM/ERP systems. - Processing returns, credit notes and repair bookings. - Supporting the coordination of specialist equipment orders. - Providing general customer service administration and sales support. - Building positive relationships with customers and colleagues. About You We are looking for a confident, organised and customer-focused individual with previous experience in a customer service or administrative position. The successful candidate will have: - Previous experience as a Customer Service Advisor, Customer Service Representative, Customer Support Administrator or similar. - Experience handling customer enquiries by telephone and email. - Strong communication and interpersonal skills. - Good organisational skills and attention to detail. - Experience with order processing or customer administration. - Confidence using Microsoft Office and CRM/ERP systems. - The ability to prioritise workloads and manage multiple enquiries. - A professional, patient and empathetic approach. - Good problem-solving skills and the ability to handle complaints calmly. - A positive attitude and willingness to work as part of a team. Salary & Benefits - £26,852 per annum. - Permanent, full-time employment. - Monday to Friday, 40 hours per week. - Office-based in Newton Abbot. - 25 days' annual leave plus bank holidays. - BHSF Healthcare Plan. - Supportive team environment. - Opportunity to work within a business providing products that make a genuine difference. Apply If you have experience in customer service, customer support, order processing or administration and are looking for your next opportunity in Newton Abbot, please apply with your CV. Pivotal Recruit, a brand of Pivotal Partnerships Ltd, is acting as an Employment Agency and advertising for this vacancy on behalf of their client.

title: Customer Service Advisor
description: Customer Support Role Technical Troubleshooting We re looking for someone who genuinely enjoys helping customers, solving problems and learning technical products inside-out. This is not a scripted call-centre role. You will be part of a small, friendly team, supporting customers with our fire safety products and systems. You ll help installers, engineers and end users diagnose issues, resolve faults over the phone and deliver an outstanding customer experience every time. You will be commercially aware and able to spot opportunities to sell through the natural flow of conversations with customers. You will have a number of years experience in a customer service environment and be a great team player. You must be comfortable speaking to customers on the phone and responding to emails. Learning and understanding our products is key to success in this role, so you should be technically curious and willing to develop your product knowledge to ensure you provide the best possible support. A willingness to learn and take a flexible approach is essential. Experience in a customer support role involving hardware and systems will be a great advantage, as will sales support experience. The full job description will be sent to you when you apply.
